objective: State one biomedical decision or knowledge gap.

questions.text: State one question that the planned evidence can answer.

inputs.description: Describe the logical input without fixing a local path.

units.description: Primary independent observational or experimental unit.

outcomes.definition: Define the primary observable outcome and its timing or measurement rule.

analysis_sets.definition: Define which units are included in the primary analysis.

steps.selection_rule: Use the applicable domain skill to select a method from the study design and data properties.

required_outputs.description: Structured results supporting the primary answer.

validation.criterion: The primary-results artifact exists and is non-empty.
